messages:
Mia: Heads-up — seeing an ECC correctable spike across p4d nodes in cluster-us-west2 between 12:03–12:15. Fleet-level correctables/sec up ~6x baseline. Proposing we discuss signal fusion before enabling wider auto-drain.

Sam: Can you paste the query? Is it card-level or host-level?

Mia: Prometheus query:
```
(sum by(card_id) (rate(nvidia_ecc_correctable_total[5m])))
```
Most pronounced on two cards (card_42, card_43) on n-gpu-pool-3.

Rachel: Are Xid errors co-occurring? If not, I prefer to avoid full drains — we saw false positives last month.

Mia: XIDs low (single digits), but PCIe parity warnings and small perf regressions on Serving metrics (p99 latency +8%).

Nate: Proposal: require 3-signal rule to trigger auto-drain: ECC rate > 4x baseline AND Xid_rate > 1 AND sustained perf delta > 5% for 10m. Add cooldown 30m + manual approval for customer-facing nodes.

Lee: Agreed on cooldown. Also add hysteresis: require metrics to drop below 2x baseline for 15m before uncordon.

Sam: We should also consider node temperature spikes — thermal throttling can cause noisy correctables. Add temp > 80C as a veto if present (don't auto-drain, alert ops).

Mia: Draft circuit-breaker config (for ops-config repo):
```
circuit_breaker:
  ecc_multiplier: 4
  xid_min: 1
  latency_pct_delta: 0.05
  sustained_window: 600 # seconds
  cooldown: 1800
  require_manual_for_labels: ["prod-customer-facing"]
  uncordon_hysteresis: 900
  temp_veto_celsius: 80
```

Rachel: LGTM. We should add a "soft-evac" step first: mark pod-level eviction with graceful timeout 15s before node drain to let short-lived in-flight requests finish. Example command:
```
kubectl -n serving evict pod --grace-period=15 --selector model=heavy
```

ops-bot: Alert created: ECC-spike-us-west2. Incident #INC-2026-138. Pager escalations set to oncall 20m.

Nate: Action items: Mia to run a tuned dry-run on canary pool (n-gpu-canary) with circuit-breaker enabled but no auto-drain, log decisions. Sam to add temp metrics to detector. Rachel to update runbook with soft-evac + manual checklist. We'll reconvene in 45m.

Mia: Starting dry-run now. Will post logs + decision JSON.

Lee: Thanks — please also capture kdump logs and note which kernel modules showed correctable counters. :thumbsup:
